newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan in close touch with US over forex-Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: Japan in close touch with US over forex-Sakakibara.

text.p: Japan is keeping in close touch with U.S. authorities on the issue of foreign exchange rates, senior Japanese Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Wednesday.
Asked whether Japan was talking with the United States on the matter of exchange rates, Sakakibara said, "The authorities are always keeping in close touch with each other."
He reiterated that Japan would take decisive action at an appropriate time. He did not say whether the government was willing to intervene now.
Sakakibara, director-general of the ministry's international finance bureau, was speaking to reporters after a speech to currency dealers.
